channel.title: SteadyDevs Blog - Legacy .NET Systems Insights
channel.description: Expert insights on maintaining, stabilizing, and improving legacy .NET systems. Practical tips and real-world case studies from 11+ years of production experience.

item.title: Self-Billed E-Invoices: The LHDN Rule Most Malaysian SMEs Don't Realise Applies to Them
item.description: You've sorted out issuing e-invoices to your customers. But there's a second obligation that catches businesses out: transactions where you have to issue an e-invoice to yourself. Here's when self-billed e-invoices apply and what your system needs to handle them.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: No-Shows Are Quietly Eating Your Venue's Margin: How to Cut Them Without Annoying Customers
item.description: An empty court at 8pm on a Saturday isn't a small loss—it's a peak slot you turned other customers away for. Here's why no-shows happen, what actually reduces them, and how to introduce deposits and reminders without scaring off regulars.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: Double Bookings Are Costing You Customers: How to Stop Them for Courts, Studios and Rental Spaces
item.description: A double-booked slot doesn't just cost you one booking—it costs you the customer who shows up to find someone else already there. Here's why double bookings keep happening even with a shared calendar, and how a proper booking system removes the problem entirely.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: Stop Taking Bookings Over WhatsApp: Why Your Venue Needs Online Booking in 2026
item.description: If your courts, rooms, tables or bays are still booked through WhatsApp messages and a shared spreadsheet, you're losing bookings to double-entries, missed messages and slow replies. Here's what online booking actually fixes—and how to add it to your existing WordPress site in an afternoon.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: AI Tools for Legacy System Maintenance: Hype vs Reality
item.description: AI coding tools promise to make maintaining old systems faster and cheaper. Some of that is real. A lot of it isn't—especially for the messy, undocumented legacy systems most businesses actually run. Here's an honest look at where AI helps and where it hurts.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: The RM30,000 Mistake: Why 'Just Add That Feature' Is Never That Simple
item.description: That small feature you asked for—the one that 'should be quick'—can quietly become one of your most expensive decisions. Here's why simple-sounding requests turn into major projects, and how to scope them before they surprise your budget.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: When 'It's Working Fine' Actually Means 'It's About to Break'
item.description: The most dangerous phrase in software is 'it's working fine.' Systems rarely fail without warning—they send signals for months first. Here are the quiet symptoms that a stable-looking system is closer to failure than you think.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: Why Your Developer Wants to Rewrite Everything (And Why You Shouldn't Let Them)
item.description: Almost every developer who inherits a legacy system will, sooner or later, propose rewriting it from scratch. Sometimes they're right. Usually they're not. Here's how to tell the difference before you commit six figures and a year of risk.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: E-Invoice Rejected by LHDN? The Most Common Validation Errors and How to Fix Them
item.description: A rejected e-invoice isn't just an inconvenience—it can hold up payments and trigger compliance gaps. Here are the validation errors Malaysian businesses hit most often with MyInvois, what each one really means, and how to resolve them.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: E-Invoice for B2C: How Retailers Handle Walk-In Customers Without Issuing Thousands of Invoices
item.description: Most walk-in customers don't ask for an e-invoice—so do you really have to issue one for every sale? Here's how consolidated e-invoicing works for B2C retail, what your POS needs to support, and the mistakes that trigger compliance problems.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: MyInvois API Integration: What Your Developer Needs to Know Before Connecting Your Legacy System
item.description: Connecting a legacy .NET system to LHDN's MyInvois API is more than a single endpoint call. Here's what actually goes into integration—authentication, digital signing, validation, and the pitfalls that catch most developers off guard.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: What a Proper System Handover Document Should Contain (Free Checklist)
item.description: When a developer leaves, the difference between a smooth transition and a crisis is one thing: documentation. Here's exactly what a proper handover document should contain—a practical checklist you can hand to any developer before they walk out the door.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: Windows Server & SQL Server End-of-Life: Is Your Legacy System Running on Borrowed Time?
item.description: Your business system works, so the aging Windows Server and SQL Server underneath it are easy to ignore. But when Microsoft ends support, those quiet servers become a security, compliance, and insurance liability overnight. Here's how to find out where you stand and what to do about it.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: LHDN E-Invoice Phase 3, 4 & 5: What Small Businesses Must Do Before the Deadline (Mid-2026 Update)
item.description: The e-invoice net has reached small businesses. If your annual turnover is between RM500,000 and RM25 million, your mandatory date has either passed or is about to. Here's the current rollout schedule, what the grace period really means, and exactly what to do now.
item.dc:creator: SteadyDevs

item.title: The Small Business Guide to System Integration: Connecting Your POS, Accounting, and Inventory

item.title: How to Add Modern Features to a 10-Year-Old System (Without Breaking Everything)
item.description: Your legacy system works, but customers want mobile apps, API integrations, and real-time features. Here's how to modernize incrementally without the risk of a catastrophic rewrite—with real examples from production systems.

item.title: Is Your Legacy System PDPA-Compliant? A Practical Guide for Malaysian Businesses
item.description: The Personal Data Protection Act isn't optional—and your legacy system probably wasn't built with PDPA in mind. Here's how to audit your system, identify gaps, and implement compliance without a costly rebuild.

item.title: 5 Questions to Ask Before Hiring a Developer to Fix Your Legacy System

item.title: The True Cost of 'Free' Technical Support from Your Developer

item.title: Should You Add Features to a Failing System? (The Stabilize-First Framework)

item.title: Your Developer Left. Now What? (Emergency Recovery Guide)
